TC-15/S25.title: Ask AI fails or returns nothing, both contexts: explicit message, no answer, question kept, not stuck in 'Searching'
TC-15/S25.detail: Spec newspec-c/flt-tc15-s25-ask-fail.spec.ts. ai/assist:askChart fails at the socket (cp1 Hospital Pre-Round, cp2 Nursing Home Encounter), then returns an empty string (cp3 Hospital Encounter, cp4 Nursing Home Pre-Round). Judged 16/16 (the failed-call checkpoints): 'The chart assistant couldn’t be reached, so there is no answer. Nothing shown here is a stand-in. Check your connection and tap Ask AI again.', 'What is the latest potassium?' still in the box, no 'Patient Record' answer block, not on 'Searching…', no WBC / mmol / mEq. Recorded (our addition, the empty reply): 'The assistant returned no answer for this question. Try asking it another way.', question kept, nothing else shown. Cross-reference: when the network itself is down (EFS/S14) the same Ask stays on 'Searching…' until the connection returns; that is judged under EFS/S14.
